file_change.purpose: Provide durable repository-local evidence resolution and explicit authority-state loading required for governed Conformance, Assurance, and acceptance lineage.
implementation: Load durable evidence only from repository-contained paths.
Reject missing, malformed, or repository-escaping evidence references.
Refuse replacement of an existing durable evidence path with different content.
Resolve acceptance evidence references before Governance consumes them.
Load explicit authority-state artifacts rather than manufacturing authority as an incidental consequence of the requesting workflow.
Construct AuthorizationGraph only from resolved authority-state data.
